research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: OOCR definition
verified_claims: Out-of-court resolutions are police sanctions used without dealing with the offence at court.
limitations: A disposal definition does not provide spatial incident evidence.

sources.name: Community resolution share
verified_claims: Community resolutions accounted for 80% of all out-of-court resolutions in 2025.
limitations: The disposal share reflects practice and is not an address-level rate.

sources.name: Drug community-resolution change
verified_claims: Community resolutions for drug offences increased by 22%.
limitations: The offence-group change is national and not parcel attributable.

sources.name: Robbery community-resolution change
verified_claims: Community resolutions for robbery offences increased by 15%.
limitations: Disposal changes do not establish robbery risk at a parcel.

sources.name: Other OOCR change
verified_claims: All other out-of-court resolution types combined decreased by 8%.
limitations: Aggregate disposal change cannot be converted to local prevalence.

sources.name: Cannabis or khat warnings change
verified_claims: Cannabis or khat warnings decreased by 90%.
limitations: Policy changes and force practice can drive this series.

sources.name: Penalty notices change
verified_claims: Penalty notices for disorder decreased by 15%.
limitations: The count reflects disposal usage rather than local safety.

sources.name: Cautions change
limitations: Caution volumes are affected by disposal policy and are not parcel evidence.

sources.name: Weapons cautions change
verified_claims: Cautions for possession of weapons increased by 3%.
limitations: The national increase does not identify weapons risk at a specific parcel.

sources.name: Public-order cautions change
verified_claims: Cautions for public-order offences increased by 7%.
limitations: A national disposal change must not be spatially imputed.
